title: CALM：文本到图像生成中全局不安全性的局限性分析
summary: 本文对文本到图像生成中"全局不安全"假设进行几何分析，揭示覆盖度与选择性的权衡：紧凑不安全子空间无法覆盖异构不安全语义，而宽泛聚合会扭曲安全相邻的良性提示。为此提出CALM，一种免训练防护方法，用提示局部反事实校正替代全局统一移除，在抑制不安全内容的同时保持良性效用。
summary_en: This paper provides a controlled geometric analysis of the global-unsafety assumption in text-to-image safeguards, revealing a coverage-selectivity trade-off: compact unsafe subspaces fail to cover heterogeneous unsafe semantics, while broader aggregation distorts safety-adjacent benign prompts. It proposes CALM (Counterfactual Adaptive Local Modulation), a training-free safeguard that replaces uniform global removal with prompt-local counterfactual correction, improving unsafe content suppression while preserving benign utility.
